header: Train-only supplement for issue 39 (deviation d3, approved 2026-09-23). Split 'train' of train-supplement.json. Authored after validation showed r6 turning 'Stop the inference container' (dev-g907, expect escalate) into a restart: the train side of dev.json holds no request to stop, shut down or disable a container or service, and Tier 2 has no such action, so the right answer is to escalate. Restart requests sit next to them as contrasts. sup-13..15 were added after r7's validation turned 'docker restart inference' (val dev-g183) into a docker.service restart: the train side has no bare 'docker restart <name>' form. These entries are never split, measured or merged into dev.json; merge_variations.py appends them to the train side only. sup-07 ('Remove the trainer container') was removed after r8: /code-review on PR 47 found it identical to a test-side entry (lapse l5), and merge_variations.py --exclude now refuses any supplement entry that repeats a validation or test entry. nginx is deliberately left out: the lead once saw a test-side entry about it (lapse l2), and this fix rests on the validation entry alone.
